title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This process ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Regularization in Ridge Regression
text: In ridge regression, regularization adds a penalty to the loss function to prevent overfitting. The penalty is proportional to the square of the magnitude of coefficients.

title: Effect of Centering on Intercept
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term is not affected by the centering process. This is because the intercept is the mean of the response variable when all predictors are zero.
